verdicts.reason: The Gale raid-weighting option is switched off, yet the raid weight is still multiplied. The settings leaf requires every setting to control its advertised effect. The raid-weighting behavior itself is not specified, but a disabled setting that still applies breaks the settings criterion.
An explicit order permits only its own trip and return. After the order completes and the game reloads, a different colonist's automatic haul enters the armed hazard, which the leaf forbids.
Common blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5, so a body of exactly 1.5 must not be blocked. Attributing all injuries to venom is also a named false pass.

The blanket is crafted from the real 40 fiber/15 felt recipe and consumed once, only when the job finishes. One saved 120-day countdown starts, the claim's duration stays frozen after the tuning change and reload, and only the new claim uses 300 days.
A canceled harvest must not debit the bank. Here the balance dropped from 3.4 to 0.4 and no felt was delivered.
Same-quality seats show the configured material comfort offset. Exactly one apparel thought appears regardless of garment count, and it is removed when all felt is taken off.
Gale should affect only unroofed living non-mechanoids. The roofed colonist and the outdoor mechanoid were also deafened.
Connected load output matches the surge factor, and surge-off holds baseline. The breakdown and the real repair are attributed separately, and uninterrupted electricity is not promised.
With no witness and the trail expired, the giant should have no knowledge of the maker. Pursuing innocent B through a nearest-pawn fallback is the named false pass.
Target selection must agree with the concealment. A hidden animal that can still be targeted is the named false pass.
The real chain runs from plans to research, build, power and RM_FogWater collection. The spawner clock survives reload, no water is produced unpowered, and no drying scar appears.
Farmer camps are a listed cut, and an active farmer camp appeared on the map.
Blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5. Blocking the 1.5 body, even if described as conservative, substitutes >= for >.
Completion and reload cannot authorize later automatic work. Dovan's ordinary haul reused Mira's stale expedition token to cross the armed island.
A saved everMature flag must keep a once-mature tree shedding at low growth. After reload the flag reads false and shedding stopped.
The maker may be identified only by witness or fresh trail, never innocent nearby B. A 'closest pawn' target after the trail expired is the forbidden substitute.
Heat-coupled consumers must emit 1.25 times the matched wood heat rate while burning cane. Equal heat per second fails this, even though the cane burn is longer.
No supplied leaf specifies which incident workers Gale raid weighting applies to. The setting controls its effect, and no criterion forbids the caravan multiplier.
